user.title: Connect to CKW
user.description: Sign in with your CKW account to read your smart meter data. Nothing more recent than yesterday is available.

meter.title: Choose a meter
meter.description: Pick the Zählpunkt (delivery point) this entry should read. {count} electricity meters are available.

reauth_confirm.description: The sign-in for {name} is no longer valid. Sign in again to keep reading its smart meter data.

init.title: CKW options
init.description: Choose how often the integration asks CKW for new meter data and whether setup imports the 730-day history.

invalid_auth.message: CKW rejected the sign-in. Please sign in again.

rate_limited.message: CKW is rate limiting requests. Try again in {reset}.

rate_limited_no_reset.message: CKW is rate limiting requests. Try again later.

range_too_big.message: CKW rejected the requested date range as too large.

api_error.message: CKW answered with an unexpected error (HTTP status {status}).

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the CKW API. Check your connection and try again.

no_meters.message: No electricity smart meter was found for this CKW account.

no_data.message: CKW returned no data that could be imported for this period.

unknown_entry.message: No CKW account has the id {entry_id}.

no_loaded_entry.message: No loaded CKW account to backfill; set up the integration first.

backfill.name: Backfill statistics
backfill.description: Import the last days of CKW daily aggregates as long-term statistics again. Use it after a meter swap or a recorder wipe; the imported sums overwrite each other instead of adding up.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: The CKW account to repair. Leave empty to repair every configured account.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days of history to import, ending yesterday.

force.name: Force
force.description: Recompute the cumulative sum from the first imported day instead of continuing the stored sum, and ignore the stored checksum.
